title: Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and tender North African dish made with lamb, preserved lemons, and aromatic spices, finished with crispy chickpeas for crunch and freshness.

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.notes: Available at most Indian grocery stores or online

instructions: In a large Dutch oven or clay tagine, heat 1 tablespoon of ghee over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee to the pot, then add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the coriander, cumin, ginger, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb back to the pot, then add the chickpeas, olives, and 1 cup of water.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb and sauce hot, garnished with parsley if desired.
Using a small bowl, toss the chickpeas with a little bit of ghee and a pinch of salt until they are evenly coated.
Spread the chickpeas on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
